en.hubeali:
And by his chain, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a slave who was between two men. So one of the freed his share and he was young, and the other one kept his share until the one who freed was old’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘His price would be evaluated on the day first freeing, and the freed one would be ordered that he work with regards to the other half which is not free, until he fulfils it’.
